excerpt_original: Territoires atlantiques To the West A visual drift across the coastline of the French Atlantic seaboard. Territories shaped by waves, tides, the blue economy. […] Cet article Véronique Zaborowski est apparu en premier sur The Eye of Photography Magazine .

blocks.text: A visual drift across the coastline of the French Atlantic seaboard. Territories shaped by waves, tides, the blue economy. Far from a touristic vision, the photographs focus on transitional spaces: marshes, coastal structures, paths, secondary ports, working infrastructures or temporarily deserted places. Human presence appears discreetly. It also reveals itself through its absence.

The project questions our relationship to a coastline that is at once inhabited and exposed, ordinary and singular. Black and white highlights the structure and materiality of the elements. In echo, colour captures the sensitive dimension of the places. A land marked by the power of the elements, as by the history of its uses.
These images are born from an intimate knowledge of these shores, and from a rediscovery.
